name: WhyGen Solar
old_description: Founded in 2020 during the global pandemic, WhyGen Solar was built to empower sales professionals in the solar industry. CEO Aaron Rice saw a critical gap—most companies focus on profits, not their sales force.
about:
WhyGen Solar was founded in 2020 in Rio Rancho, New Mexico, during the COVID-19 pandemic. CEO Aaron Rice started the company after recognizing a gap in the solar industry: most firms prioritized profits over their sales force. Rice, influenced by Simon Sinek's "Start With Why," built the business around the idea that supporting sales representatives leads to better customer outcomes.

The company provides residential and commercial solar installation services across New Mexico, Arizona, and Colorado. Its offerings include direct purchase, loan financing, and lease or power-purchase agreements, each backed by warranties covering parts, labor, and in some cases system production. WhyGen Solar does not manufacture equipment; it designs and installs systems using third-party components.

The customer base spans homeowners seeking to reduce utility bills and businesses aiming for sustainable energy. Residential clients can choose from zero-down options with tax incentives, while commercial customers receive tailored system designs. The company cites its BBB A+ rating in the Southwest Region as a marker of service quality.

WhyGen Solar differentiates itself by investing heavily in sales-rep training and support, arguing that empowered representatives deliver a superior client experience. This people-first philosophy, rooted in the founder's reading of "Start With Why," remains the core of its operational model.
